mapper.sql: e.id, e.receipt_no, e.category_id, e.title, e.description, e.amount, e.currency, e.spent_on, e.vendor, e.payment_method, e.status, e.submitted_by, e.approved_by, e.approved_at, e.paid_at, e.notes, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, c.name as cat_name, s.nick_name as sub_name, a.nick_name as app_name
from nad_expense e left join nad_expense_category c on c.id = e.category_id left join sys_user s on s.user_id = e.submitted_by left join sys_user a on a.user_id = e.approved_by
mapper.insert: insert into nad_expense (receipt_no, category_id, title, description, amount, currency, spent_on, vendor, payment_method, status, submitted_by, approved_by, approved_at, paid_at, notes, create_by, create_time) values (#{receiptNo}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{spentOn}, #{vendor}, #{paymentMethod}, #{status}, #{submittedBy}, #{approvedBy}, #{approvedAt}, #{paidAt}, #{notes}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update nad_expense set receipt_no = #{receiptNo}, category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, amount = #{amount}, currency = #{currency}, spent_on = #{spentOn}, vendor = #{vendor}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, status = #{status}, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, approved_at = #{approvedAt}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, notes = #{notes}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select max(cast(substring_index(receipt_no, '-', -1) as unsigned)) from nad_expense where receipt_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')

select coalesce(c.name, 'Uncategorised') as bucket, e.currency as currency, sum(e.amount) as total, count(*) as count from nad_expense e left join nad_expense_category c on c.id = e.category_id where e.status in ('APPROVED', 'PAID') and e.spent_on >= #{from} and e.spent_on <= #{to} group by bucket, e.currency order by total desc
select id, code, name, sort_order as sortOrder, active from nad_expense_category where active = 1 order by sort_order, name
select id from nad_expense_category where lower(name) = lower(#{name}) limit 1
